elements.requirement: References to gain and loss in sections 2 to 4 of the Fraud Act 2006 must be read in accordance with section 5.
elements.quote: references to gain and loss in sections 2 to 4 are to be read in accordance with this section

elements.requirement: The terms 'gain' and 'loss' extend exclusively to gain or loss in money or other property.
elements.quote: extend only to gain or loss in money or other property

elements.requirement: The terms 'gain' and 'loss' include any gain or loss in money or other property whether it is temporary or permanent.
elements.quote: include any such gain or loss whether temporary or permanent

elements.requirement: The term 'property' means any property whether real or personal, including things in action and other intangible property.
elements.quote: “property” means any property whether real or personal (including things in action and other intangible property)

elements.requirement: The term 'gain' includes a gain made by keeping what one already has, as well as a gain made by getting what one does not have.
elements.quote: “Gain” includes a gain by keeping what one has, as well as a gain by getting what one does not have

elements.requirement: The term 'loss' includes a loss suffered by not getting what one might get, as well as a loss suffered by parting with what one has.
elements.quote: “Loss” includes a loss by not getting what one might get, as well as a loss by parting with what one has
